samples.summary: Documented contract is now only partially true: many hand-rolled error emitters still print pretty-printed, multi-line envelopes without `command`, while README.md:117 and docs/design/cli.md §9 state the envelope is *a single JSON line* carrying `command`. The task file (docs/tasks/active/20260811-cli-error-envelope-command-todo.md:19-22) explicitly defers these to #654/#655, so this is scope-consistent — but until those land, a caller following the documented line-delimited contract will still hit multi-line envelopes from `files/upload.ts` (errorJson, `null, 2`), `docs/import.ts:200-204,244-248`, `slides/import.ts:244,312`, `notes/import.ts`, `commands/schema.ts:34`, and the forwarded backend bodies in `docs.ts:195/255/307`, `notes.ts:148/203`, `slides.ts:154/204`. Worth a one-line caveat in README/cli.md §9 ("paths that forward upstream bodies are pending #654/#655") rather than leaving the spec overclaiming.
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/files/upload.ts:227 `return JSON.stringify({ error: { code, message } }, null, 2);` vs docs/design/cli.md:1017-1018 "Errors: a single JSON line on stderr with shape {\"error\":{\"code\",\"message\",\"command\"}}"

samples.summary: `ctx list/switch`, `login`, `logout` and `status` emit bare text on stderr (`'Not logged in. Run `wafflebase login`.'`, `Workspace not found: ...`) and never go through `outputError`, so they produce no envelope at all — no `code`, no `message`, and now no `command` either. docs/design/cli.md §8.1 says errors are JSON so agents can parse success and failure uniformly, and §8.4 lists `ctx.list`/`ctx.switch`/`login`/`logout`/`status` as first-class schema commands. The change threads attribution through every namespace command but leaves these auth/context commands outside the envelope entirely; the issue plan does not list them, so this is a pre-existing gap that this change makes more visible rather than one it introduces.
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/commands/ctx.ts:61 `console.error('Not logged in. Run `wafflebase login`.');` — the actions at ctx.ts:44/58, status.ts:8, logout.ts:8 are arrow functions with no `outputError` call at all.
searchedFor: grep 'outputError' across packages/cli/src (all call sites listed)
